name: Sword Circle ⚔️
desc:
⭐ Can you be the last one standing each round?

- ⚔️ Fight other players with your sword on top of a shrinking platform
- 💪 You get stronger with each kill!

CONTROLS:
ATTACK- R2/Tap Screen/Left Click
BLOCK - F/L2/Tap UI Button
SHIFTLOCK - Shift/Button-Y/Tap UI Button

👍 Like & favorite for updates!  :-) ❤️

Do not exploit. You will get banned.
